rules.objective_policy: Keep all targets in reserved block excluded from development evaluation.
rules.x_y_key_separation: Keep predictors, labels and linkage keys separated in all artifacts.

metrics.event_definition: Onset event: target period with y=1 and previous target period y=0 for the same municipality.
metrics.anticipation: One-step issuance: each prediction is evaluated at its own target period (t+h).
metrics.evaluable_population: Rows with known binary y and required prediction fields.
metrics.unknown_periods_treatment: Exclude unknown previous periods from onset denominator and report non-evaluable status.

determinism_limits: No candidate model stochastic training in this delivery.
Deterministic references depend on zone state availability and valid temporal linkage.
Notebook receipts depend on kernel package versions.
